data.name: Space Avenger – Empire of Nexx
data.detailed_description:
"Nice job Rookie! But to be perfectly honest… I didn´t think you would make it."

The Empire of Nexx grows unchecked, conquering world after world. All seems hopeless.. What can one Rookie pilot do? Can one person change the fate of the galaxy?

About the game:

Space Avenger is a super fast paced top down arena rogue shooter with multiple ships and over 90 upgrades that will aid you in your war against the Nexx Empire. Travel through intense battles across nearly fifteen worlds as you attempt to fend off the Nexx. Fight against gigantic bosses and use an ever-expanding devastating arsenal to overcome all the challenges that await you. The all-powerful Nexx Empire has declared war on humanity!

Features:

  • Superfast science fiction arcade arena shooter!
  • Extraterrestrial firepower, weapons and upgrades!
  • An awesome SciFi story full of suspense and action!
  • Multiple ship types
  • Deep ship upgrade system for custom combat styles

#MadeWithFusion

reviews.review:
After several hours in this game, I have come mainly to one conclusion. I feel bad for the money I spent. The game is basically a mediocre shooter with mobile style controls (you autoaim nonstop with almost no control over where to aim) and there is a horrible grind to it.

The graphics are servicable, the sound is servicable, nothing breathtaking. It's not technically *bad*. It just makes you wonder after paying 15 bucks what you paid for.

The writing in the game contains errors after you switch to english, typos or even words leftover in french. There are no mouse controls but the game has buttons...? Why?

Furthermore, the biggest challenge in the game is either being overwhelmed by enemies because you didn't grind enough to get better weapons, of which there are only 3 main weapons locked to shiptypes, minus the skills you use, OR the fact that some enemies can simply outright murder you without you having any chance to fight back. Some basic enemies can oneshot you with insanely fast missiles and they don't fire a single one, no, they fire several. Also they can and will fire from offscreen and they fly faster than anything else in this game, making dodging impossible.

So you die randomly.

Then you grind so you don't die. And even after that you still die. <- this is the non fun part

The grind consists of running the same missions over and over again on easy mode, because there is literally no point in going for medium or hard since you get the same payout. And then you make like... in the beginning about 300 stars maybe? Middle game 700? depends where you grind and how good you are. And then you have upgrades that give you tiny advantages that cost you like 3000+ stars.

Grind. Die. Repeat.

Eventually you progress, which is not something you can really enjoy because all the game does is throw more enemies at you. I rarely had a moment where I can say "I got here because of skill, not luck". This is what pains me. The bossfights are decent, those are actually fun. They are not random. The bosses don't use unreasonable weapons to artificially make the game hard. The rest of the game is just a slog.

For 12,49€... yeah, I should have gotten something better. The quality is not there and the game is ultimately not motivating.
